title: Lifting ordinary scalar association through the scalar counits
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$ and $f:X\to Y$, Chern data $c_Y,c_X$ [def-sp-tower-class-chern], geometric tower data $b,g$ [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], and intermediate integral pullback data $d$ [def-sp-tower-chern-pullback-intermediate]. Put $E_T=c_T.\mathrm{scalar.model.E}$, $S_T=c_T.\mathrm{scalar.T}$, $P=d^*$, $Q=g^*$, and let $s_{R_T},s_{A_T}$ be the degree-zero single functors. Assume an ordinary natural isomorphism $\alpha:E_YQ\simeq PE_X$ and assume that $P$ preserves the flat-term K-flat resolving class [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. There is a natural transformation $\kappa:S_YQ^D\to P^DS_X$ commuting with the specified integer shifts such that, for every whole $R_Y$-module system $M$, $\kappa_{s_{R_Y}M}\,S_X(p_M)\,q_{X,PM}=Q^D(q_{Y,M})\,r_{E_YM}\,s_{A_X}(\alpha_M)$. Here $q_T=\mathrm{scalarSingleCounit}(c_T)$ [def-sp-tower-scalar-single-counit], $p:s_{R_Y}P^D\simeq Ps_{R_X}$ and $r:s_{A_Y}Q^D\simeq Qs_{A_X}$ are the canonical exact-derived single comparisons. Compositions are read from left to right. No coefficient-unit or root endpoint normalization is assumed or asserted.

proof.text: The scalar-model shift is the left-adjoint shift for normalized exact restriction. Take the inverse mate of the exact restriction localization factor. The normalized derived-unit equation identifies this mate with the universal scalar counit on K-flat complexes; resolving augmentations and naturality identify it on all complexes. Thus both scalar computation counits commute with the specified shifts.

Form the two natural computation maps on all cochain complexes: source scalar counit followed by exact geometric pullback factors and termwise alpha, and exact integral pullback factors followed by the target scalar counit. Both maps are invertible on flat-term K-flat representatives, the second by the assumed preservation of K-flatness. Compose the first with the inverse second. Fully faithful restriction to resolving representatives descends this isomorphism to the two derived composite functors.

The counit equation holds on resolving representatives by construction. For an arbitrary complex choose a flat-term K-flat resolution augmentation. Naturality of the two cochain computation maps and invertibility of the augmentation after localization extend the equation to that complex. The computation maps commute with shifts; cancel the target computation on resolving representatives and transport along derived isomorphisms to prove CommShift.

Evaluate the counit equation on the degree-zero single complex. Expand the canonical exact-derived single comparisons and scalarSingleCounit; the single/localization comparison is reflexive. Cancel the functor images of identities. Naturality of the target scalar counit along the ordinary integral single comparison and naturality of the exact pullback factor along the source scalar single comparison reduce both sides to the degreewise ordinary alpha square. That square follows in degree zero by functoriality and outside degree zero by the zero maps.

theorem tower_scalarPullback_counitLift
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    {b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E} (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f)
    (cY : Chern l E Y) (cX : Chern l E X)
    (d : IntegralCoefficientPullback l E f cY cX)
    (α : cY.scalar.model.E ⋙ g.pull ≅ d.pull ⋙ cX.scalar.model.E)
    (hflat : ∀ (P : CochainComplex (Systems Y (Rrings l Y)) ℤ),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
        (R := WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.systemRing
          (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (fun n ↦ (Rrings l Y).obj (Opposite.op n))
            (fun n ↦ (Rrings l Y).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)) P →
      (∀ i : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite
          (J := WeilConjectures.coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y))
          (R := WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.systemRing
            (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (fun n ↦ (Rrings l Y).obj (Opposite.op n))
              (fun n ↦ (Rrings l Y).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)) (P.X i)) →
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
        (R := WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.systemRing
          (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (fun n ↦ (Rrings l X).obj (Opposite.op n))
            (fun n ↦ (Rrings l X).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op))
        ((d.pull.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) :
    ∃ κ : cY.scalar.T ⋙ SpTowerShriek.pull l E b g ⟶
        d.pull.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ cX.scalar.T,
      NatTrans.CommShift κ ℤ ∧
      ∀ M : Systems Y (Rrings l Y),
        κ.app ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems Y (Rrings l Y)) 0).obj M) ≫
            cX.scalar.T.map ((d.pull.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app M) ≫
            (scalarSingleCounit cX).app (d.pull.obj M) =
          (SpTowerShriek.pull l E b g).map ((scalarSingleCounit cY).app M) ≫
            (g.pull.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app (cY.scalar.model.E.obj M) ≫
            (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems X (Arings l E X)) 0).map
              (α.hom.app M)
